themes.name: AI compute: NVIDIA's supply chain
themes.what: Super Micro said on Oct 20 that September quarter revenue will be $18.5 to $19.5 billion, up from its $14.5 to $15.5 billion guide and above the $15.23 billion consensus, with gross margin of 12.0% to 12.5%; the stock rose about 12.7% after hours. The same day the Wall Street Journal reported Anthropic's draft IPO filing: first half revenue of $16.3 billion, a net loss of $80.7 billion (about $72 billion of it non cash) and compute commitments reported above $600 billion. Demand is still rising, and stock markets are becoming the main funder.
themes.for_you: No action before Meta reports tonight. SMCI has no dashboard verdict. NVDA is 'Buy zone, wait for the chart' (217.09 on Oct 19) because sellers lead; ORCL stays Wait. NVDA and ORCL are left out of both lists until Meta's capex guide shows whether the biggest buyer is still raising spend; META is left out until it reports.

themes.name: Defense, drones and reshoring
themes.what: Northrop Grumman reported Q3 on Oct 20: sales $11.1 billion, up 7%, EPS $7.89 against $7.18 expected, a record $109.6 billion backlog on a 1.5x book to bill, and a 2026 EPS guide raised to $29.35 to $29.75 from $28.60 to $29.10. The stock rose 4.57%. Management expects about 35% of the backlog to turn into revenue within 12 months.
themes.for_you: No buy yet. NOC is Wait on the dashboard (510.65 on Oct 19, above its 502.90 zone top, in a downtrend, sellers leading at 0.73). Hexcel, a composites supplier to engines and airframes, reports tonight.

themes.name: Healthcare and Medtech: Aging, Heart, Sugar, Hearing, Sight
themes.what: Intuitive beat on Oct 20 (revenue $3.05 billion, up 22%; adjusted EPS $3.00) but US da Vinci procedures grew only 10% against 20% abroad, it took a $450 million antitrust settlement charge, and it plans extended use instruments, volume pricing and China cuts that lower instrument revenue per procedure 3% to 5% by the end of 2027. It traded near $406 after hours from a 438.00 close. On Oct 21 Abbott matched estimates (adjusted EPS $1.42), cut 2026 comparable sales growth to about 6%, and said it will spin off its $8.5 billion Nutrition business by the end of 2027.
themes.for_you: Long term: ISRG ('Accumulate on pullback', 433.18 on Oct 19) is near its 395.07 thesis line after hours; wait for a fresh close and buyers on volume. ABT (104.06 on Oct 19) could drop into its 98.30 to 100.45 zone; it needs the chart checks too. MDT and JNJ, the new US robot rivals, are left out of both lists: lower Intuitive pricing makes their entry harder even as its slowdown opens a door.

themes.name: Space, Quantum and Cyber: Government Funded Frontier Tech
themes.what: SpaceX reported Q3 on Oct 20: revenue $14.6 billion, up 161%, with its AI unit at $7.56 billion, more than half of sales, and net income of $4.4 billion; Q3 capital spending was $19.6 billion and Q4 is guided at $35 to $40 billion. Musk said SpaceX and Tesla boards formed special committees to explore a merger, with no terms and Musk not on either committee. SPCX rose about 4.8% after hours.
themes.for_you: No action. SPCX has no dashboard verdict and TSLA is rated Avoid and reports tonight. TSLA is left out of both lists: a merger could add SpaceX's growth or dilute holders, and no terms exist.

innovations.name: Healthcare
innovations.what: Rechecked on the daily rotation. Intuitive's Q3 (Oct 20) showed revenue of $3.05 billion, up 22%, and about 14% da Vinci procedure growth, but US procedures grew only 10% against 20% abroad. It plans extended use instruments and other price moves that cut instrument revenue per case 3% to 5% by the end of 2027, and took a $450 million antitrust settlement charge. The stock traded near $406 after hours from 438.00. Gene editing (lonvo-z decision March 10, 2027), AI diagnostics (Medicare fee schedule final rule due early November) and brain implants had no new milestone; no FDA action on CagriSema has been reported.
innovations.for_you: Long term: ISRG ('Accumulate on pullback', 433.18 on Oct 19) is near its 395.07 thesis line after hours; wait for a fresh close and buyers on volume before any buy. Stage stays early adoption: lower prices per case are a push toward wider use, not proof of it. MDT and JNJ are left out of both lists.

countries.name: Brazil
countries.what: Polls published Oct 20 mostly lean to Flavio Bolsonaro: Real Time Big Data (Oct 15 to 19, 2,000 voters) has 52% to 48% of valid votes, Gerp 53% to 47%, Alfa 51.5% to 48.5% and Instituto Franca 50.8% to 49.2%, while Data Ranking has Lula 50.4% to 49.6%. The Ibovespa rose 1.57% to 208,295.98 and the real firmed to about 5.02 per dollar.
countries.for_you: No action until after Sunday's vote. NU closed 15.09 on Oct 20 (Yahoo), just above its 15.07 zone top on Oct 19 data. Markets already price a Bolsonaro win, so a Lula win is the bigger move; no Brazil puts before Monday.

countries.name: European Union
countries.what: France's National Assembly set the revenue vote on the 2027 budget for Nov 3 instead of Oct 20 (TokenPost, Oct 20), so Moody's reviews France's Aa3 negative rating on Oct 23 with no budget passed. The prime minister promised more curfews after the worst unrest in years, and the CAC 40 fell 0.38% to 7,838.49 with French 10 year yields near a 24 year high.
countries.for_you: No action. SAN and ING are left out of both lists: higher rates help their margins, French stress hurts European bank spreads. Wait until after Moody's on Friday. No dashboard name is French.

countries.name: Gulf (Saudi Arabia, UAE, Qatar, Iran risk)
countries.what: Iran's Revolutionary Guards said on Oct 20 that mines stopped three tankers near Hormuz, two of them on fire; CENTCOM called the claims false and said the international waterways are cleared of mines, and no ship names have appeared. Brent touched $111.99 and settled at $108.79, down 0.69%, as Pakistan's army chief took a mediation plan to Tehran. United guided Q4 jet fuel at $4.80 a gallon against $3.90 in Q3.
countries.for_you: If you hold energy swings, keep the stops; oil is trading headlines with a $6 daily range. No airline buys or puts. FRO is left out of both lists: attacks raise tanker rates but also the risk to ships.

countries.name: Japan
countries.what: The Nikkei fell 1.30% to 64,075.42 on Oct 20 as SoftBank and chip suppliers sold off, then rose 0.85% to 64,621.24 on Oct 21, with Advantest up about 5.3% and Tokyo Electron about 3.0%, after Super Micro and SpaceX results. A 20 year JGB auction drew record demand on Oct 20.
countries.for_you: No action. The chip rebound is one day old; the BOJ meets Oct 30. SONY is left out of both lists because the moves were about chips.

countries.name: South Korea
countries.what: The KOSPI closed down 3.73% at 5,552.74 on Oct 20, its lowest close since April 7, then rose 3.29% to 5,735.66 on Oct 21 as foreigners bought a net 660 billion won; Samsung rose 5.67% and SK hynix 5.81%. The won firmed to 1,325.2 per dollar, and chip exports in the first 20 days of October rose 222.5% from a year ago.
countries.for_you: No action before the Bank of Korea decides tonight (9pm ET). KB and SHG are now mixed: a stronger won and the chip rebound help, a November hike risk cuts the other way. Only 372 stocks rose against 488 that fell, so this was a two stock rally, not a broad turn.

countries.name: Taiwan
countries.what: The Taiex fell 1.13% on Oct 20, then rose 594.84 points, or 1.28%, to 46,887.77 on Oct 21, led by AI server makers after Super Micro raised its September quarter revenue outlook to $18.5 to $19.5 billion (Focus Taiwan).
countries.for_you: No action before Meta's capex guide tonight. Taiwan's server makers are the first to feel a change in that number. TSM is left out of both lists because its own news has not changed.
